name: Maria Faraday
source: A spunky, athletic, and upbeat personal trainer that is always trying to help others. Her friendly personality makes her easy to befriend, but her immense passion sometimes can explode from friendliness to anger when the wrong things are said. A good friend, a dangerous enemy, and a woman dead set on achieving her mysterious goal.
